paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper presents exclusion limits on three main coupling types: (1) dark matter-electron cross section σ̄_e for light dark matter (LDM) scattering with heavy and light mediators, (2) axioelectric coupling g_Ae for axion-like particles (ALPs), and (3) dark photon kinetic mixing κ. The pre-analysis hint correctly identified AxionElectron as the primary coupling type. Data points extracted from text descriptions of newly excluded parameter space: ALPs constrained between 0.03–0.2 keV/c² (converted to eV: 3e-2 to 2e-1 eV), and LDM-electron scattering limits at 16–56 MeV/c² (heavy mediator) and above 80 MeV/c² (light mediator). Exact coupling values read from Fig. 2 description are approximate due to figure resolution. The experiment assumes Standard Halo Model with local DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/(c² cm³). Confidence is moderate (0.75) because while the coupling type is clear, precise numerical values from the figure are difficult to extract without higher-resolution data; the text provides mass ranges and qualitative statements about excluded parameter space rather than explicit tabulated (mass, coupling) pairs. The paper also constrains dark photon kinetic mixing κ and sterile neutrino mixing |U_e4|², but AxionElectron (g_Ae) is the primary new constraint matching the pre-analysis hint. | selector: text (sole candidate)
